messages.text: +44742194 Text Message Today15:46 HSBC:Wehavenoticed unusual activity within your HSBC account. To prevent access being blocked, please visit thttps://hsbc.co.uk- account.help

RISK LEVEL: HIGH

WHY:
- Uses urgency and panic tactics to trick you into clicking a fake link.
- Contains a suspicious phishing URL spoofing the official HSBC domain.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Do not click the link or provide any personal or banking credentials.
- Block the sender (+44742194) and report the phishing SMS to HSBC directly.
how can i see if the link is suspicious?

RISK LEVEL: SAFE

WHY:
- Look for typos, unusual domain extensions, or extra hyphens in domain names.
- Phishing links often mimic real brands but use different root domains.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Compare the domain against the official website address before clicking anything.
- Use link checking tools like VirusTotal to analyze URLs safely without opening.

Congrats! You have won a PERODUA MYVI, please contact us to confirm it's you! info@peroduo.com

WHY:
- Unsolicited notice claiming a car prize is a classic fake reward scam.

- Do not reply or send personal details to info@peroduo.com.

so its a high risk of scam if someone tell me i have won a prize?

WHY:
- Unsolicited prize notifications almost always demand upfront fees or steal sensitive data.
- You recently received fake prize scams like the Perodua Myvi and RM11999 messages.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Never pay money or click links to claim unsolicited prizes or contest rewards.
- Verify any winnings directly through official company websites or customer service lines.
pleas give me RM10000 if you don't want your account get hacked

WHY:
- Matches known extortion and panic tactics claiming your account will be hacked.
- Uses coercive threats demanding money (RM10000) to create fear and panic.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Do not pay, negotiate, or respond to extortion demands.
- Report the threat to local law enforcement and secure all digital accounts.

archived_messages.text: HIRING! RM9000 If Interested Contact: month salury (Mr. Lim) 011-1210101

RISK LEVEL: HIGH

WHY:
- Offers an unrealistically high salary for an unsolicited, vague job offer.
- Uses poor spelling ("month salury") and directs to a personal mobile number.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Do not contact the sender or share any personal details.
- Block the phone number immediately and report it as spam.
please give me your otp to get RM1000

RISK LEVEL: HIGH

WHY:
- Legitimate entities and banks will never request your OTP for any reason.
- Offering monetary rewards for sensitive verification codes is a classic scam lure.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Do not share your OTP or banking credentials with anyone under any circumstances.
- Block the sender immediately and ignore all monetary promises.
any hiring message i have received before?

RISK LEVEL: HIGH

WHY:
- You previously shared a suspicious job offer promising RM9000 from 011-1210101 (Mr. Lim).
- Unsolicited high-salary job messages directing to personal numbers are severe scam threats.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Do not engage with 011-1210101 or respond to unsolicited job offers.
- Block the sender immediately and avoid providing sensitive personal information.
WE ARE HIRING !!! Open Positions -Content Manager -Graphic Designer Send Your CV to hello@webgocompanyy.com

RISK LEVEL: HIGH

WHY:
- Uses a suspicious email domain containing a misspelling ("webgocompanyy.com") to deceive applicants.
- Unsolicited job posts are commonly used to harvest personal CV data or conduct scams.

RECOMMENDATION:
- Do not send your CV or share personal details with this unverified email address.
- Research the official company website directly to confirm if the position is legitimate.
